title: Take-up Rate for Skillsfuture Courses amidst COVID-19 Pandemic
what_it_is: Take-up Rate for Skillsfuture Courses amidst COVID-19 Pandemic

sections.label: E-learning course growth
sections.summary: Approved e-learning courses grew from about 60 in December 2019 to more than 2,800 by September this year, including over 2,000 converted this year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: The number of courses approved to run in e-learning mode has also grown from about 60 in December 2019, to more than 2,800 as at September this year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: These include over 2,000 courses that were converted from in-person or blended learning mode to e-learning mode this year.

sections.label: Skills training enrolment and outreach
sections.summary: About 1,700 enrolled in SGUnited Skills and Mid-Career Pathways programmes, over 2,100 used Skills and Training Advisory, and over 700 workshops reached over 14,000 participants.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: As at end of August this year, about 1,700 individuals have enrolled in the SGUnited Skills and SGUnited Mid-Career Pathways (Company Training) programmes.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: SSG has also introduced a new Skills and Training Advisory service in this period.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: From January to September this year, over 2,100 individuals have tapped on the Skills and Training Advisory service.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: SSG also continues to partner the People's Association and the Community Development Councils or CDCs to run SkillsFuture Advice workshops and webinars.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: These have been stepped up this year, in particular with the SkillsFuture@CDC initiative.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Thus far, we have delivered more than 700 physical and virtual workshops to over 14,000 participants.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: And I have personally participated in a few myself.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: We will continue to enhance outreach efforts to ensure that Singaporeans are aware of the reskilling and upskilling opportunities and support available.
